tools.name: complycube_list_clients
tools.description: List the clients (people or companies) on the account, newest first. Each client has an id, type, contact details and metadata. Use this to find a client id before running a check. ComplyCube API: GET /v1/clients.

tools.name: complycube_get_client
tools.description: Get one client by id: type, contact details, personal details or company details, metadata and timestamps. ComplyCube API: GET /v1/clients/{clientId}.

tools.name: complycube_create_client
tools.description: Create a client record before running checks on it. Give personDetails for type person, or companyDetails for type company. Store only the fields the checks need. The new client id comes back in the reply. ComplyCube API: POST /v1/clients.

tools.name: complycube_list_checks
tools.description: List checks (identity, document, AML screening and others), newest first. Filter by client, check type, status (pending, complete, failed) or outcome (clear, attention, not_processed, rejected). ComplyCube API: GET /v1/checks.

tools.name: complycube_get_check
tools.description: Get one check by id: its type, client, status, and the result (outcome and the breakdown of each part). Use it to read the result of a screening check after it completes. ComplyCube API: GET /v1/checks/{checkId}.

tools.name: complycube_create_aml_check
tools.description: Start an AML screening check for an existing client: sanctions, PEP and watchlist screening. Standard is the basic screen; extensive is the full screen. The check runs in the background and counts against the account's monthly check quota. Read the result later with complycube_get_check. ComplyCube

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: complycube_create_aml_check · Private data: complycube_list_clients, complycube_get_client, complycube_create_client, complycube_list_checks · Public sink: complycube_create_client, complycube_create_aml_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: complycube_create_aml_check · Private data: complycube_list_clients, complycube_get_client, complycube_create_client, complycube_list_checks · Public sink: complycube_create_client, complycube_create_aml_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
